adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies each legacy `embeddable_hosts` line directly into the new `embeddable_hosts.host` column via raw `execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`, bypassing `EmbeddableHost`'s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. The new allow check (`EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`/`host_allowed?`) parses the *request* URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, i.e. it expects the stored value to be a bare hostname. If the old setting contained entries like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (which the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` explicitly supported by parsing URI hosts), those will be stored verbatim and will never match `uri.host`, causing embeds from previously-allowed hosts to be rejected (403 via InvalidAccess).
